items.title: 3 S&P 500 Stocks for Long-Term Investors

items.title: A Tax Strategy So Aggressive It Built the World’s Largest Hedge Fund and Made Losing Money the Hottest Product on Wall Street
items.summary: Cliff Asness spent three decades fuming that taxes destroyed more investor wealth than bad stock picks ever did, so he built a fund that turns losing money into the actual product. What regulators are now calling potentially abusive, his clients are calling the smartest trade on Wall Street.

items.title: Nobody Warned Her That Two Retirement Accounts Meant Two RMD Rules, a 25% Penalty

items.title: Everyone’s Arguing About Taxing the Rich. Almost Nobody Noticed the $1 Trillion Already Slipping Past the IRS
items.summary: While politicians battle over wealth taxes and fair shares, a legal industry worth well over a trillion dollars is already engineering those rates into irrelevance for the nation's biggest fortunes, and it is growing faster than any bill Congress could pass.
